decisions.reason: Because this portable reference electrometer is very close to the firm's core dosimetry and QA instrument capabilities, and the firm has strong in-house scientific expertise, calibration resources, and research links, management is likely to see good scope to learn and improve rather than withdraw it.

Because this oncology risk management software builds on the firm's established QA and software integration offer and the firm has high absorptive capacity from its broad product base, expert staff, and EU research participation, management would likely retain it and refine it despite somewhat higher software-market uncertainty.
